info.title: Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji — Knowledge Base API
info.description: Read-only API over the verbatim Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji corpus (60,658 lines, 1,430 Angs). Gurmukhi is served exactly as it appears in the source; English is a separate, labelled translation layer. Every scripture citation is "Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji · Ang N". Generated by tools/gen_openapi.py; response schemas are inferred from real responses.

servers.description: Same origin as the web app (the gateway routes /api/*).
